description: Matrix 1S 5IN1 II FC, explicit component neighbourhoods, three compliant mount grommets, four black screw heads, motor/camera wiring, Racing tube antenna and power pigtail.

provenance.note: 1.0 mm substrate and three 26 mm nominal mount lugs are retained. Frame screw axes remain at 25.5 mm pitch. There is deliberately no front PCB lug.

Board body now follows centrally approved26.4mm side estimate with16.2mm front and16.3mm side/rear clips. The shared26mm lug pitch and1mm substrate are unchanged. Top package sizes stay fixed; package centres follow the registry, with rigid pin/solder-cap offsets preserved.
The published pitch mismatch is preserved as 0.353553 mm radial eccentricity between nominal PCB lugs and assembled screws. Silicone shape accommodation is plausible but unverified.

Named package placements follow the labelled FC top-front image: STM32 left-forward; gyro and MM32 forward; VTX processor right-forward; flash left-rear; ESP/SX rear; u.FL central-forward; CAM IN central-right. Exact pin counts, electrical nets and hidden package geometry are simplified.

Tube antenna uses frozen base/tip/radius anchors and tapered heatshrink. Cable paths and exposed lengths are illustrative, below propeller plane where crossing the rotor regions; no wiring connectivity or harness-length certification is claimed.

White/blue pigtail and connector are represented in an unplugged dry-display pose. Optional battery geometry is owned separately and this connector is not claimed to mate in the battery-equipped assembly.

provenance.feature: Assembly screw axial engagement after spatial auditSP-01
provenance.note: Representative installed extent follows shared frame/canopy anchors. Length and thread geometry are unmeasured; fitted intervals are checked in evaluated Blender geometry.

Own-drawn textures replace four raised text objects. Only readable physical marks are reproduced; placement/typeface/grain are approximate. Right-lug pad count corrected from four to three. No source-photo mapping or invented serial/lot markings.

Eight uniform placeholders replaced by VTX, AT7456E, four controller and eight power-package estimates.0.85 fit removed after central26.4mm board revision; outer power centres adjusted0.5mm per XY axis to clear connector housings. Four motor connectors/last two wire control points relocated coherently; housing dimensions/Z/rotation and mounts preserved. Heights/lead counts simplified. Polygon uses central clip parameters to preserve lug bores.

provenance.feature: PCB review perimeter and passive correction
provenance.note: Moved two overhanging fore passives and NW gyro rigidly inside board; corrected nearby passive orientations/clearances with both terminations. Added missing two MCU lead rows, with estimated lead count. Added 17 selected underside passive bodies in visible fore-tip and central-package banks, with rigid solder ends; no added labels or blanket printed pattern. One ambiguous central passive omitted to preserve clearance from VTX leads.

nodes.notes: Three side/rear corners terminate before lug holes; front corner is clipped and has no mounting lug.
